payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: complete: the overall image consistently reads as a chalk drawing, with drawing-like rendering across the scene rather than merely a chalk-like overlay or texture; the scene and subjects may be preserved. partial: visible progress toward a chalk drawing, such as chalky grain, smudging, or sketch-like outlines, but substantial areas or details still read as photographic or the overall image remains mixed. absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. unknown: evidence is insufficient to judge the overall rendering. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Requested transformation: render the image as a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
